A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same MergeMix research work. All 29 pages of each version, including Appendices A–F, are available and readable; text comparison and visual inspection support reliable matching of equations, tables, and figures.

before.justification: v2 reports original image-classification and MLLM experiments, ablations, calibration and efficiency measurements, and audio-classification results in Appendix C.3.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results in the main text and appendices, including the audio experiments in Table A8.

M1.justification: Sections 4.1–4.2 and Algorithms 1–2 retain the same token-merging augmentation, mixing-ratio re-scaling, classification objectives, and mixed SimPO alignment procedure. Appendix B.4 proposes future extensions without changing the implemented method.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same five image-classification datasets, MLLM benchmarks, ESC-50 and UrbanSound8K audio experiments, and occlusion and token-compression scenarios. The new future-work citations introduce no evaluated coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in corresponding main-text and appendix experiments, including VisionThink in Table 5 and Re-Align and vanilla SimPO in Table A13. The newly cited works are not added as evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: Section 5.3 is condensed but retains the same resolutions, training budgets, optimizers, learning rates, and model settings documented in Appendix B.2. Renaming the Appendix D.2 evaluation from LLM-as-the-Judge to VLM-as-the-Judge leaves its evaluators and procedure unchanged.

E4.justification: Both versions contain the same component and ranking-loss ablations, hyperparameter sensitivity, occlusion robustness, calibration analyses, mixing-ratio reward evaluation, and visualization case studies. No analytical evidence is added or removed.

E5.justification: The uncertainty reporting in Table A8 is retained, including its existing ± values. No repeated-run, seed, uncertainty-estimation, or statistical-testing information is added or revised.

E6.justification: Result entries in Tables 1–8 and A1–A15 and the plotted findings are unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains MergeMix's 78.68% DeiT-Small accuracy, and Table 5 retains its 64.07 average. Table A1 changes highlighting rather than scores.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and formulations in Equations 1–12 are unchanged, including mask generation, ratio re-scaling, and preference losses. No formal assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about unified augmentation, bridging SFT and RL, classification performance, and MLLM alignment and generalization.

C2.justification: Appendix B.4 adds discussion of selecting better non-preferred examples from multiple augmentations and constructing them through image editing. This modestly extends the future-work discussion beyond the retained limitations of untouched text inputs and static token merging; existing result interpretations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: The shortened implementation description preserves the technical information already provided in v2 and Appendix B.2. Pseudocode, hardware disclosures, hyperparameters, and the code-access statement remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Appendix B.4 adds citations to RewardMap, Can MLLMs Guide Me Home?, and Free Lunch for Stabilizing Rectified Flow Inversion to motivate future preference-pair construction. The existing related-work section and central novelty positioning are unchanged.

P1.justification: v3 condenses Section 5.3, makes localized wording and terminology corrections, fixes an Appendix F figure reference, and adds acknowledgements and an ICLR 2026 publication header. The section organization and most prose remain intact.

P2.justification: Figures and tables are retained with localized spacing and placement adjustments and revised captions for Figures 1, 2, and A2. Table A1 adds cyan second-best highlighting to AutoMix's unchanged 73.40 result for ViT-Base at 200 epochs. The underlying graphics are unchanged.

improvement.justification: v3 provides limited improvements in clarity and presentation: clearer captions, corrected second-best highlighting in Table A1, and an Appendix F reference corrected from Figure A6 to the relevant GradCAM Figure A8. Appendix B.4 modestly broadens the future-work discussion. These gains leave the scientific claims, experimental evidence, and reproducibility information unchanged.
